           <lg><l> <note type="gloss">(rgyu mtshan gang*** na)</note> <note type="gloss">bshad par dam bca'</note> don gnyer skyes bus <note type="gloss">lha (gcig ?) ston **</note> bskul byas bas ||</l>
           <l><lb edRef="inst:5892" n="1b2"/> <note type="gloss">rgyu gang gis 'bri na | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs></note> bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin gyis ||</l>
           <l><note type="gloss">tshig dang don khyad par</note> rtogs <note type="gloss">(gang gis gsal byed na)? </note>dka'i mdo'i <note type="gloss"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3693">sdud pa</rs></note> tshig don gyi ||</l>
           <l><note type="gloss">gang na</note> gsal byed cung zad <note type="gloss">gang gis na</note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3816">bdag</rs> gis <note type="gloss">bshad gzhi</note> bri <note type="gloss">snying rje chen <abbr>bas so</abbr></note>||</l></lg><!--Similar introductory verses in 1_002_03--></seg></TEI>
